notes.title: UI Update and polishing devlog
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just popped a speedy 2 minute devlog on the JackaCreates youtube channel, if you're interested in the development of the game head over there give it a look.

To sum up, I've been working on making the UI and end screen match the style of the game with new fonts, outlines, added a cheeky new death animation and sorting out the combo meter.

Progress is getting there and I'm hoping to get the game released next year, possibly around febuary although that date's subject to change
